The conversion lead is responsible for:

  • Working with business and IT stakeholders to develop the migration strategy and high-level design.
  • Providing guidance and leadership to conversion developers.
  • Liaising between the different conversion development teams as well as with business and IT Stakeholders.
  • Leading mock conversions and dress rehearsals.
The conversion lead should understand technology architecture for the data conversion and have experience with both agile and waterfall project management styles.
